note: RegioJet night trains, one entry per direction, keyed by Back-on-Track's own bare train number so the trainsByNumber enrichment lands each on its row (7 = Praha–Chop 1020/1021, 261 = Praha–Przemyśl 1022/1023). Every entry is a NAMED ORIENTED pair because one train number is two trips in this feed: 1020/1021 runs as the Praha–Košice train under route 8870969001 and, the same night under the same number, as the Praha–Čop portion under route 8185007005 (board in CZ/SK, alight only at Čop, and the reverse). Naming the Čop terminus selects the portion Back-on-Track's row describes. from/to are the feed's own spellings, matched accent-folded and prefix-wise, so "Čop" matches "Čop, žst.". Route ids are NOT used: the Přemyšl route moved from 8393687006 to 8534213024 and its trains from 1038/1039 to 1022/1023 between two feed drops, which is what left the old hand-run parser publishing a timetable that no longer existed.
